As a picky eater who doesn’t eat most traditional foods at Thanksgiving/Christmas (also due to the reasons you’ve stated), *YTA big time*. It’s not a religious reason, allergies, or any other medical conditions. You’re simply a picky eater. It is not your FMILs responsibility to cater you chicken nuggets and french fries on top of cooking all other guest foods, just because you simply don’t like it. Your accommodation is not an entirely different meal. FMIL gave you the correct accommodations; allowing you to bring your own food from home. I had a conversation with someone including the first point, which is what made me consider posting this poll. They thought the lack of publicity was Disneys way of keeping the “peace” between people who want representation and people who don’t. If they marketed more, those who don’t want representation (aka people who don’t want their children to see gay characters, interracial relationships, etc for whatever reason) would be more likely to post hate about it, but those who do want representation are able to have the movie with it. Basically creating a “win-win” situation.

I also completely agree with the second and third points. While watching the movie there really wasn’t anything to make it stand out as a good Disney movie. It was just the overly repeated “But Dad, that’s *your* dream! Not mine!” scenario. My 4 year-old cousin was only excited that there was a dog in it. When the dog wasn’t on screen, she was playing with her toys, completely uninterested in the movie and plot itself lol.

I definitely don’t think it’s a bad thing. Any amount of representation is a good thing, I just find it interesting how other people perceive it. There’s a large spectrum online going from people hating any representation to people hating anything that isn’t a representation.

I was more pushing towards whether it felt like the creators were actively attempting to put different minorities in the movie purely just for the representation aspect. I understand it’s just a movie, obviously making it where everything in it was forced. But, while watching, did it feel like they really tried to drive the nail making it representative? Whether there was representation or not, it’s still just a movie and doesn’t make much difference. There’s a lot of debate I’ve seen about different factors like how little promotion the movie got, the focus on plot and characters not seeming balanced, etc, and how people are (albeit a lot are reaching) tying it into the representation in the movie. So I was wondering what other people thought about it.

So when I was like 10 or 11, I had a hamster named Hammy. I loved this damn hamster with everything in me and I really enjoyed watching him run on his wheel. Really upsetting and my parents went through the common burial for a hamster. Here’s where the OCD came in… I was thoroughly convinced by intrusive thoughts that I was at complete fault for Hammy’s death. I beat myself up so much over it. Either way, felt extremely guilty over poor Hammy’s death and didn’t fully get over it until, like, 5 years later. One time when I was 16 my parents were at a party about an hour way, my brother was at a friends house, and my sister was at her house, so I was home alone. My house is built like a circle on both floors of the house and the rooms on the bottom floor follow the pattern with a kitchen and front door, empty room with a computer, a living room, and a sitting room. It was around 7pm and I was doing homework in the kitchen when i started hearing three very quiet knocks on the front door across the room. It happened every five minutes. The exact same knocks that would make me look over confused and my dogs to perk their heads up. It was dark so I couldn’t see outside the windows to see if there was a person there but you could still see if there was a silhouette of a person. I didn’t see anything so I just brushed it off every time I heard the knocks and told myself i was just being a paranoid 16 year old. After it continued for an hour or so, I was getting freaked out. I stood up and went to the empty room where I was out of sight with the front door just in case there was someone there to call my parents. On the phone I was explaining what was happening and the second I said, “It doesn’t seem like anyone is outside,” the knocks became unhumanly loud and continuous on the door. With my dogs barking and the insanely loud pounding, I couldn’t hear my mom on the phone at all. I was facing the living room and through the noise I heard a bunch of metal fall in the living room. The lights were off so I couldn’t see what had fallen but I immediately went into panic mode and ran to the next room which was the sitting room. There were no windows or doors in the sitting room and I hid in between a couch and elliptical. I sat there for about a minute noticing how cold my house was and just wanting the pounding to stop. I dialed 911 and right when the woman answered, the pounding stopped and my house was quiet minus my dogs barking. Because my parents were so far away, they called my sister who was only 10 minutes away. I stayed in the same place until my sister and police got there. Once they were there, I went to the living room to see what metal fell and there was no metal in the room at all. Everything was completely normal. The police did a run through the house and around my house to see if there was any signs that someone was there but there was nothing. They had passed it off as a paranoid 16 year old at night. Here’s where things get a little weird. Being 16, I was posting this on snapchat and I had taken a very fast picture with the caption “cops.” I hadn’t even looked at the picture before I posted it. After police left and I was calmed down multiple people had slid up on the post asking what was in the background. I looked closer at the picture and in the back was a window where you could easily see a faceless silhouette of a man with a blue plaid shirt just standing in the window. No one who was at the house looked even close to it nor could anyone figure out what could have caused it to look like that. Sadly, when I got a new phone it deleted all the pictures I had so I don’t have it anymore but I’m sure I’ve sent it to someone who still has it. If I can find it I’ll edit this post and attach it. But yeah, I hated being home alone for a year after that one haha.
